title: Proposal
description: Decision-ready options addressing a stated pain, grounded in validated evidence. See /artifacts/proposal.md.

kind.description: Proposal category. 'lesson' is produced by the Learning Agent; 'knowledge' is the standard ingestion-pipeline proposal.

pain_statement.description: Who hurts and how. Required by Constitution Article XII — features/knowledge must solve a real pain point.
examples: Engineers building multi-agent retry logic re-derive backoff parameters from scratch each time, causing inconsistent behavior.

options.description: Candidate options addressing the pain, each with honest trade-offs.

tradeoffs.description: Honest trade-offs of adopting this option.

recommended.description: Set true only for genuinely preferred option(s); never mark all options recommended.

success_metrics.description: Measurable metrics that would indicate the proposal succeeded if adopted.

non_goals.description: Explicit statement of what this proposal does not attempt.

citations.description: Links from proposal claims to accepted evidence. Every evidence_id must resolve to an accepted result in the referenced ValidationReport.

evidence_id.description: Must reference an accepted evidence_id in the linked ValidationReport.

pointer.description: Optional convenience copy of the underlying provenance pointer.

requires_human_approval.description: Must be true whenever adoption would authorize a downstream Knowledge Plane (SoR) mutation.

validation_report_ref.description: Pointer to the sealed ValidationReport this proposal draws its accepted evidence from.

risks.description: Optional risks this proposal itself introduces if adopted.

examples.pain_statement: Engineers building multi-agent retry logic re-derive backoff parameters from scratch each time, causing inconsistent, sometimes retry-storm-prone behavior across services.

options.summary: Publish a canonical jittered exponential backoff guideline.
options.tradeoffs: Low implementation cost; requires periodic review.

success_metrics: Reduction in retry-storm incident reports within 2 quarters.
non_goals: Does not mandate a specific retry library.
risks: Guideline could become stale if published without a review cadence.
